5056095713207.sourceDescription:
Fill your home with festive colour with our Pre-Lit Fraser Fir Christmas Tree. Its traditional shape and realistic mixed foliage create a beautiful backdrop for treasured ornaments, while dual multi colour and warm white LED lights bring a cheerful sparkle to the branches. Available in heights, 6ft, 7ft and 10ft.

This Fraser Fir makes a welcoming focal point for Christmas celebrations. A blend of PE tips and PVC tips gives the tree texture and fullness, ready to dress with family favourites or a fresh decorating theme.

With the lights already fitted, you can spend more time enjoying the decorating. Choose from 9 multifunction light settings, including a steady glow, playful twinkle and gentle slow fade, to set the mood for cosy evenings or festive gatherings. The LEDs are mains powered through a low voltage transformer.

Hinged branches fold down for assembly, and a folding metal stand is included. Take a little time to spread the branches and arrange the individual tips to reveal the tree's full shape, then add your decorations for a personal finishing touch.

Features:
 Light functions: 9 multi function settings
 Power supply: Mains powered with a low voltage transformer
 Realistic mixed PE and PVC foliage
 Traditional Christmas tree shape
 Hinged branch construction
 Folding metal stand included
 For indoor use only

For the best finish, gently spread the branches and arrange the individual tips to bring out the tree's full shape before decorating.
Height: 10ft / 3m
Diameter: 196cm
Tip count: 3353 (1016 PE and 2337 PVC)
Lights: 1150 multi colour LEDs
Guarantee - 1 year
Tool free assembly

Light up your Christmas spirit with the Bishop's Pine—where every branch tells a story.

Step into a world of festive wonder with the 180cm prelit Bishop's Pine Tree, designed to transform your home into a winter paradise. With its generous 675 tips and beautifully hinged branches, this tree offers both lush fullness and effortless assembly, ensuring your holiday decorating is a joyful experience from start to finish. The 290 warm white bulbs, delicately nestled among the green and white flocked needles, cast a cosy, inviting glow that brings families together and ignites cherished memories. Crafted from a harmonious blend of PVC, PE, and realistic pine needles, every detail is meticulously considered for longevity and authenticity. A sturdy metal base and generous 104cm girth provide impressive stability and presence, while the discreet green cable and ample 3-metre lead blend seamlessly into any indoor setting. The Bishop’s Pine is not just a tree; it’s the radiant centrepiece of your seasonal celebrations, inspiring joy, warmth, and togetherness year after year.

Choose from 8 different lighting modes: Combination, Steady on, Slow Fade, In waves, Slow glow, Chasing/flash, Sequential and Twinkle flash. The lights also include a timer, a static setting and a memory function, allowing them to start backed up with your previously chosen setting, automatically turning on for you when it gets dark.

DIMENSIONS: This tree stands at 5 feet high and the base has a diameter of 25cm. WEIGHT: 3KG

PRODUCT FEATURES
Clear plastic ball baubles designed as fillable spheres for Christmas tree hanging decoration. The transparent design lets you see and display small items placed inside, making them suitable for personalised festive ornaments. Available in 6cm, 8cm and 10cm sizes, so you can choose the diameter that suits your decorating needs. Supplied in pack quantities of 5pcs, 10pcs or 20pcs depending on the option selected. The hanging design allows them to be suspended from Christmas tree branches and used as decorative baubles during the festive season.

PACKAGE INCLUDES
Clear plastic ball baubles, in the selected variant. Style and quantity depend on the selected option.
CLEAR DESIGN FOR PERSONAL TOUCHES: Transparent plastic baubles showcase your chosen fillings, making it easy to create decorations that complement your Christmas theme.
EASY TO FILL: Simply remove the top cap, add small, lightweight decorations such as confetti, paper or ribbon, then refit the cap before hanging.
THREE SIZE OPTIONS: Choose from 6cm, 8cm or 10cm diameters to suit your Christmas tree, hanging display or craft project.
PACKS TO SUIT YOUR PROJECT: Available in packs of 5, 10 or 20 baubles for individual creations, coordinated displays or group crafting activities.
VERSATILE CRAFT DECORATIONS: Create personalised Christmas ornaments, wedding favours, party decorations and gift embellishments. Fillings and styling accessories are not included.
Guarantee - 1 month

This Christmas decoration adds a festive detail to your Christmas display.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display

5056928934007.sourceDescription:
Welcome the festive season in rustic style with this 50cm pine cone and bauble Christmas wreath from MySmartBuy. Generously packed with real pine cones, many with frosted white tips, it is decorated with shiny red baubles, clusters of red berries, birch-style log slices and touches of faux greenery for a natural, wintry woodland look. The real pine cones give it an authentic texture and character that you simply cannot get from an all-artificial wreath, while the red baubles and berries add a cheerful pop of Christmas colour. It looks equally at home in a country cottage, a traditional family home or a modern space with natural, Scandi-inspired decor. A hanging hook makes it easy to put up on a front door, an interior door, a wall or above the mantelpiece. At 50cm in diameter, it is a generous statement size that can be seen from the street and makes a real impression as guests arrive. To keep it looking its best, bring it indoors in bad weather. A beautiful way to give your home a warm festive welcome, and a lovely seasonal gift for anyone who loves natural, rustic Christmas decor. At a glance: 50cm diameter wreath | real pine cones with frosted tips | red baubles and berries | log slice and faux greenery details | hanging hook | bring indoors in bad weather.
FESTIVE WREATH – Faux greenery with shiny baubles and berries.
REAL PINE CONES – Decorated with natural pine cones for a rustic touch.
HANGING HOOK – Ready to hang on a door, wall or above a mantelpiece.
50CM DIAMETER – A generous statement size.
CARE – Bring indoors in bad weather.

Christmas Wreath
This Christmas wreath adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The green finish and plastic construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Product details
Material: Plastic. Colour: Green. Stated size: 150 cm. Quantity: 1 piece.
Festive green plastic wreath designed to add a defined decorative detail to your Christmas display.
Generous 150 cm diameter size creates a prominent focal point for doors or walls.
Durable plastic construction ensures the decoration maintains its shape and appearance.
Versatile indoor holiday accessory suitable for coordinating with existing seasonal decor.
Comes with 1 x Christmas Wreath

Christmas Decoration
This Christmas decoration adds a festive detail to your Christmas display.

Lightweight Design
The lightweight form is convenient to handle and move between suitable locations. It also makes the item easier to include when organising a bag or storage space.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Product details

Lightweight design allows easy handling and convenient storage between seasons.
Natural wood material provides a classic aesthetic for Christmas displays.

Strong Adhesion: Reinforces flat joints and internal corners for extra strength
Crack Prevention: Helps prevent cracking at joins and patch repairs
Easy to Apply: Simple to cut and embed using standard jointing compound
Versatile Use: Suitable for all plasterboard wall and ceiling applications
Extra-Long Roll: 90-metre length provides excellent value and coverage for larger jobs
